name: review
description: Perspective-diverse code/design review with adversarial finding refutation

tasks.prompt: Review objective/change strictly for reachable correctness, data/control-flow, compatibility, error-path, concurrency and regression defects. Prove findings from repository evidence. Subject: {{objective}}
Perform passive scoped security review only. Confirm reachable findings; no active scan/exploit. Subject: {{objective}}
Review strictly for performance, throughput, resource, distributed-failure, migration and operability regressions. Require realistic trigger/evidence. Subject: {{objective}}
Review strictly for missing/invalid acceptance, tests, accessibility, data/AI evaluation, rollout and release evidence. This is review, not final release gate. Subject: {{objective}}

Refute each proposed finding by checking trigger, reachability, evidence and scope. Deduplicate root causes, discard unsupported claims, run completeness critique, and report only verified findings plus explicit coverage gaps. No voting. Findings: {{dependencies}}
